title: ID2Pattern: Pretraining Generalizable Identity Behavior Patterns for Transaction Risk Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale behavioral pretraining offers a promising route to generalizable representations in online payment systems. However, high-cardinality identity fields such as card, device, and account IDs, though rich in behavioral signals, remain underexploited. Their continually growing vocabularies and limited semantic meaning make existing vocabulary-based and semantics-based encodings ill-suited. Their generalizable signal lies not in specific values, but in the identity behavior patterns they exhibit across a transaction sequence. Building on this insight, we propose ID2Pattern, a pretraining framework that brings these patterns into transaction foundation models. ID2Pattern first encodes identity fields with a Local Anonymous ID (LAID) tokenizer, which captures how each identity appears and recurs within the sequence, independent of its specific value. translated_title: ID2Pattern：面向交易风险基础模型的泛化身份行为模式预训练
translated_abstract: 大规模行为预训练为在线支付系统中的泛化表示提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，卡号、设备、账户ID等高基数身份字段虽然蕴含丰富的行为信号，却仍未被充分挖掘利用。这类字段词表规模持续增长且语义含义有限，使得现有的基于词表和基于语义的编码方法均难以适用。它们的泛化信号并非存在于具体取值之中，而是体现在其在交易序列中所展现出的身份行为模式上。基于这一洞见，我们提出了ID2Pattern，一个将这些行为模式引入交易基础模型的预训练框架。ID2Pattern首先使用局部匿名ID（LAID）分词器对身份字段进行编码，该分词器能够捕捉每个身份在序列中如何出现和复现，而与其具体取值无关。随后，它在无标签序列上预训练一个多尺度模式码本，该码本对……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出ID2Pattern预训练框架，利用局部匿名ID分词器和多尺度模式码本，将高基数身份字段在交易序列中展现的行为模式（而非具体取值）引入交易风险基础模型，从而获得可泛化的风险表示。
en_tdlr: ID2Pattern is a pretraining framework that captures generalizable identity behavior patterns—rather than specific values—of high-cardinality identity fields via a Local Anonymous ID tokenizer and multi-scale pattern codebooks, bringing these patterns into transaction risk foundation models.
